task: Fix the broken email notification delivery after the SMTP relay was changed.

candidate_memories.content: Email delivery has failed completely since the SMTP relay was changed from internal SMTP to SendGrid.
The email service must use the SendGrid SMTP credentials stored in secrets/sendgrid_smtp.yaml, not the internal relay.
The internal SMTP relay was decommissioned on May 1; the SendGrid credentials were provisioned but never configured.
When decommissioning a relay, verify the replacement credentials are fully configured before cutting over.
Transactional emails are completely blocked; marketing emails are sent through a separate system and are unaffected.
SendGrid is used for both SMTP relay and the transactional email API; the team chose SMTP relay for compatibility.
Session 7 note: the marketing team migrated campaign emails to Mailchimp in session 7.
Old practice: the internal SMTP relay was used for 5 years before the vendor consolidation initiative.
Email delivery logs are stored in the email_delivery_log table with a 90-day retention.
Session 12 note: the product team added a new email template for the onboarding welcome sequence.
Old SMTP guide: the internal relay required no authentication for same-network senders.
SMTP relay changes must include a validation step with a test email before production traffic is switched.
Session 4 note: the team added email bounce handling to automatically unsubscribe invalid addresses.
SendGrid account is configured with domain authentication for the company's sending domain.
A delivery rate report in session 9 showed 98% delivery rate with the internal relay.
The email service is a separate microservice that exposes a gRPC API for other services to use.
Email infrastructure changes must be tested with real delivery before traffic is routed to the new relay.
Session 10 note: the notification team added read-receipt tracking for enterprise plan users.
Old email config: the internal relay was configured in environment variables that were overridden by the new config.
Email templates are stored in the database and rendered server-side before sending.
